regime.detail: Stocks are falling while Treasury yields fall, so money is moving into bonds.

read: The S&P 500 rose 4.7% on Monday, Nov 23 and fell 2.4% over the past week. The VIX closed at 26.6.
Over the week, the 10-year yield fell 20 bp to 4.92%, oil fell 6.3%, gold fell 5.7%, the dollar rose 0.8%, and chip stocks fell 0.4%.
Strongest sector this week: Semiconductors (−0.4%). Weakest: Energy (−6.0%).
The biggest news themes right now: AI & chips, Inflation, jobs & economy, Trade, tariffs & China.
